snapshot.scope: Independent Product Planning review of the next private ingress snapshot slice on the reviewed-task baseline: post-Send accepted files bind exact Job/source/ordinal/checksum bytes, reference-original body readers never use live paths, recovery-safe cleanup is proven, authored ambient intent remains separately reviewed, and statuses remain unchanged.

reviewers.task: Private ingress snapshot lifecycle on reviewed-task baseline
reviewers.independence: Product Planning reviewed Source Storage, Job, Data, Security, architecture, decision and trace owners against the read-only body-access call graph; Development owns snapshot, promotion, resolution and recovery implementation.

dimensions.summary: Post-Send descriptor/file ownership, managed-copy adoption, reference-original reads, restart retention and terminal cleanup have one bounded lifecycle.
Source, Job, Data, Security and architecture agree on private identity, no live-path body input and authored ambient intent as a separate authority.
Vault, Job and Security requirements plus E2 gaps bind executable proof without Requirement, Exit or Phase promotion.
Development has bounded Capture, shared source-file-access and Job cleanup owners plus failure/restart tests without public schema or UI work.
Existing owners and one decision carry the next slice with no new document, public DTO, status or permission mode.

verification.evidence: Source strategy, Job recovery, private-path and authored-intent boundaries remain single-owned without new IPC/schema values.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions && npm run verify:documentation-leanness
verification.evidence: Owner links, lifecycle decision and governed byte limits pass without a new document.
PIGE-VAULT-003, PIGE-JOB-002, PIGE-SEC-003 and E2 gaps bind planned implementation proof without status promotion.

coordination.compatibility: Neutral attachments keep exact-source snapshot tools; explicit authored tasks may request precise ambient confirmation/plans with or without attachments. Raw Shell remains per-effect and no saved grant/YOLO exists.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning freezes accepted-file snapshot/promotion/body-resolution/recovery semantics only; implementation, executable evidence, UI and status promotion remain outside.

nonBlockingRisks: Development must prove no accepted reference-original body reader bypasses shared source-file access to consume a live original path.
Crash, cancellation, partial rejection, drift and cleanup tests must retain needed snapshots and reap only revalidated terminal/orphan ownership.
The reviewed-task implementation remains independent; attachment presence neither grants nor forbids its explicit authored-intent boundary.
